correctness.rationale: The all-length proof reduces prefix-normality to minimal spans of consecutive one positions and checks all window-length ranges for the two exceptional run gaps. The admissible run-length domains are disjoint; summation gives the stated rational function, and the pole-order argument gives 7/24. Packaged direct and recurrence-based finite checks corroborate every tested coefficient, without being mistaken for an infinite proof.
